mentions.name: Caliper
mentions.description: This tool sets code quality guardrails for AI-generated code. It extracts deterministic quality checks from a project's CLAUDE.md and runs them after every agent turn, performs a lightweight AI-powered review at every commit with feedback sent directly to the coding agent, and runs a deeper 'traditional' AI review at merge time or on demand. It is free to use with a bring-your-own API key.
mentions.problem: Setting strong code quality guardrails in an era where most code is not handwritten.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm continuing to focus on ways to set strong code quality guardrails in an era where most code is not handwritten.

The result is http://getcaliper.dev.

mentions.name: Caliper
mentions.description: Caliper is a code quality system for AI-powered software development that runs multiple layers of checks throughout the dev cycle: lightweight checks after every agent turn, with increasingly complex checks pre-commit and pre-merge. It catches violations of a project's own conventions (as defined in CLAUDE.md) immediately and gets the model to make corrections before small issues become costly to unwind.
mentions.problem: With high AI-generated code volumes, code review only as a final check before merge is too late and too burdensome; 40% of agent turns produce code that violates a project's own conventions.
mentions.source_excerpt: That's why I built Caliper (http://getcaliper.dev). It's a system that institutes multiple layers of code quality checks throughout the dev cycle. The lightest-weight checks get executed after every agent turn, and then increasingly more complex checks get run pre-commit and pre-merge.
